images.caption: At the Corbet Station This is where the old G.N.R.(I) Knockmore Jct - Castlewellan line cut under the Drone Hill Road just south of the Corbet. It was here that the Corbet station stood - opened in 1882 and closed, with this section of line, in 1955. The trackbed and station have long since disappeared under this field.

images.filename: Statue of John Mitchel in Newry, Northern Ireland.jpg
images.caption:
Statue of John Mitchel in Newry, Northern Ireland inscribed
"John Mitchel
1815-1875

After twenty seven years in the exile for the sake of Ireland he returned with honor to die among his own people and he rests with his parents in the 1st presbyterian old meeting house green at Newry."
images.alt:
Statue of John Mitchel in Newry, Northern Ireland inscribed
"John Mitchel
1815-1875

After twenty seven years in the exile for the sake of Ireland he returned with honor to die among his own people and he rests with his parents in the 1st presbyterian old meeting house green at Newry."
